wholePhysicalScope: The twenty-four French cadastral vertices distributed through OSM way 107251244 establish the two square pavilion footprints, attached wings, and shallow front and rear central risalits.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the twin square pavilions, curved slate roofs and open lanterns. Closer levels refine limestone medallions, dormers, sash and the entrance stairs.
limitations: The 2010-era south elevation is reconstructed from one exact released photograph and cadastral geometry. Rear fenestration, individual stone carvings, chimney sections, roof profile and vertical measurements are approximate.

The source terrain is unchanged. The east lawn samples are higher than the west side, so foundation exposure varies. The central threshold and step fit are approximate. The historic park, kennels, original outbuildings and interiors are outside scope.
